inputs.share_count_basis: Weighted average diluted shares for 1H 2026 (H1 FY2026 interim note 7: 1,143,491k). Held FLAT: SBC is fully expensed in the flows (immaterial, ~0.05% of revenue) and buybacks (RMB955m FY2025, RMB285m 1H 2026) are what keep the count from drifting; no non-SBC issuance modelled.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 annual report cash flow statement, 'Share-based payments expenses' RMB16,422k (2018.HK_Annual_FY2025.txt:5710); no net-share-settlement tax line (EquityAwardTaxes = 0 all years). FY2024 was a RMB5.1m reversal.
inputs.fx_note: Statements in RMB (functional currency Renminbi; filings RMB'000, modelled in RMB millions). HKEX quote in HKD. Per-share values computed in CNY and converted at CNY->HKD 1.1724 (Yahoo CNYHKD=X, regularMarketTime 2026-10-16T22:02Z). Parity check: no dual listing exists; direction checked by magnitude (FY2025 diluted EPS RMB2.18 x 1.1724 = HK$2.56, giving a trailing P/E of ~14x at the HKD quote, consistent with consensus framing of AAC at low-to-mid-teens P/E). refresh_price.py does not move this rate; re-date it on any later refresh.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in CNY/HKD terms: China 10y govt ~1.9%, plus a HK-listed China-manufacturing ERP of ~6.5% x beta ~1.15 = cost of equity ~9.4-9.9%; debt is cheap (bank loans 2.1-4.2%, notes) but small at ~6% net gearing, so WACC 9.5% is essentially the cost of equity. Single WACC across scenarios: smartphone cyclicality and Apple concentration are priced in the scenario flows and weights, not stacked as a premium (adaptation f).
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (B), leases as operating cost: FY2025 lease cash of RMB254m (principal 217.2 + interest 36.6, FY2025 AR lines 5777/6817) = 0.8% of revenue deducted via lease_cost_pct_path; lease liabilities (RMB1,048m at 30 Jun 2026) EXCLUDED from net debt; total_debt is bank loans + unsecured notes only. D&A path is ex right-of-use depreciation (~RMB150-200m/yr) so the lease is not charged twice in cash-tax EBIT.
inputs.nci_treatment: NCI charged once, in the bridge: flows are 100% consolidated and the NCI equity stake (RMB622.4m at 30 Jun 2026, H1 FY2026 balance sheet) is deducted in equity_bridge. NCI P&L share is ~1% of group profit (FY2025 RMB33m), so book is an adequate proxy.
inputs.notes: Model: owner-FCF DCF (component route) with non-US/cyclical adaptations. AAC is an operating precision-components manufacturer (acoustics and electromagnetic drives, optics, precision mechanics and heat dissipation, automotive acoustics via PSS, sensors/semis) -- routing row 'operating company, non-US or cyclical'. First valuation of this ticker; no prior DCF or memory entry. Normalisation: reported FCF is lumpy -- FY2020-21 were negative on RMB2.2bn of equipment deposits inside capex, and FY2023-25 were flattered by RMB0.6-0.9bn/yr working-capital releases (cash conversion cycle cut to <20 days). The forward build therefore uses mid-cycle components (capex 8.4-8.8% of revenue vs 7.5-8.4% FY2023-25 and 14-23% FY2017-21; working capital consuming 8% of each revenue increment) rather than FY2025's 14% FCF margin; year-1 owner-FCF margin ~8%, against a FY2017-25 cumulative reported FCF margin of 7.9%. Interest income (RMB193m) not stripped: the group is net debt, not net cash. Bridge timing: FY0 revenue is FY2025 while debt/cash/shares are 30 Jun 2026 -- the 1H 2026 cash flow sits inside year 1 and the balance sheet, a small conservative overlap. Buybacks: active repurchaser (RMB955m FY2025), so the flat count is funded. SBC-zero market in practice: house and street differ by ~0.05% of revenue and the band is not meaningful.

equity_bridge.note: H1 FY2026 balance sheet line 2338 (RMB531,466k); fair-value gains/losses are excluded from the EBITDA path, so the asset is added here

historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5yr CAGR (2.9%) diverges sharply from revenue (13.2%) and EPS (11.8%): equity has been held flat by dividends plus RMB2.1bn of buybacks FY2021-25 and by the FY2019-23 earnings trough (EPS 4.35 in FY2017 -> 0.60 FY2023 -> 2.18 FY2025). EPS 3yr 48.9% is a trough-recovery figure, not a run-rate. Forward base growth is set from segment evidence and 1H 2026 (+8.9%), not from any of these CAGRs.
historical_growth.notes: Owner FCF = reported FCF - SBC (interest not stripped; net debt). FCF 3yr CAGR FY2022->FY2025 (2,334 -> 4,485) is flattered by working-capital releases; 5yr CAGR undefined because FY2020 owner FCF was negative (-659, equipment deposits). SBC is immaterial so the SBC-adjusted and reported FCF CAGRs coincide.

base.narrative: FY2026 ~+8% (1H +8.9% with optics -23% offset by acoustics/EM drives +14%, auto acoustics +23%, heat dissipation ~5x). EBITDA margin holds ~20% (FY2022-25 band 19.9-20.6%) with mix gains offset by auto-acoustics and optics price pressure. Capex disciplined at ~8.5% of revenue, D&A converging down from the FY2017-21 capex wave. Cash tax ramps from ~15% (HNTE) toward 17% as overseas (PSS) profit grows.

bull.narrative: The 'RMB10bn-scale' new tracks deliver: VC/active-cooling becomes standard in flagship phones and spills into servers, data-centre liquid-cooling CDUs scale, robotics motors and AR waveguides reach volume, and WLG wins CPO optics. Revenue compounds ~10% for five years, mix lifts EBITDA margin toward 23% (still below the FY2017-18 35%), at the cost of slightly heavier capex.

bear.narrative: Memory-cost inflation and a smartphone unit downturn (IDC -4% to -7% in 1H 2026) squeeze handset BOMs; a major customer dual-sources acoustics/haptics or in-sources, optics keeps losing volume, and Chinese automakers' price war erodes auto-acoustics margin further. EBITDA margin falls to 16.5% (between the FY2020-25 ~20% and a structural de-rating), growth stalls, capex cannot fall because the equipment base must be refreshed for each product cycle.

scenario_narratives.base: Handset components plateau (optics and casings under ASP/volume pressure) while acoustics/EM drives share gains, automotive acoustics (PSS) and the heat-dissipation ramp carry mid-single-digit group growth; margins hold near the FY2022-25 ~20% EBITDA band, capex stays disciplined at ~8.5% of revenue.
scenario_narratives.bull: AAC's materials/precision platform converts into the new tracks management sizes at RMB10bn-scale -- flagship VC and active cooling, data-centre liquid cooling, robotics actuators, AR waveguides, WLG for CPO -- so revenue compounds ~10% and mix pushes EBITDA margin toward 23%.
scenario_narratives.bear: Customer concentration bites: the largest customer re-sources or squeezes price as memory costs eat handset BOMs, optics keeps shrinking, auto price war compresses PSS margins, and the group is left a low-growth, capex-heavy supplier at ~16.5% EBITDA margin.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised to 25% from the 15% default: revenue is concentrated in a handful of smartphone OEMs with one dominant customer, smartphone units are falling in 2026, and FY2017-23 showed EBITDA margin can halve in a down-cycle. Base 50%: 1H 2026 is tracking it. Bull cut to 25%: it needs several independent new businesses (cooling, robotics, AR, CPO) to scale at once, none yet a material share of revenue except heat dissipation.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Mid-cycle owner-FCF valuation of a cyclical, customer-concentrated precision-components maker. Year-1 owner FCF is built from components at ~8% of revenue rather than FY2025's 14% reported margin, which included working-capital releases that cannot recur and follows years in which equipment deposits made FCF negative. Risk is charged in the flows and weights, once.
key_risks_to_valuation: Customer concentration: loss of share at the largest smartphone customer
Smartphone unit decline and memory-cost squeeze on handset BOMs (1H 2026 IDC -4.1%/-6.7%)
Capex cycle relapse: FY2017-21 capex ran 14-23% of revenue
Automotive acoustics price war compressing PSS margins (1H 2026 GM -3.2ppts)
CNY/HKD rate: per-share HKD values move one-for-one with CNYHKD
